prompt: I need to set up a basic Watermill router in Go using GoChannel as the pub/sub mechanism. It should have a single handler that listens to 'incoming_topic', prepends 'Processed: ' to the message, and publishes to 'outgoing_topic'. Please scaffold this for me.

assertions.name: compiles
assertions.description: The generated code is complete and correctly imports Watermill and standard libraries.

assertions.name: router_setup
assertions.description: It initializes a message.Router with a logger.

assertions.name: pubsub_setup
assertions.description: It initializes a gochannel.GoChannel as the Pub/Sub.

assertions.name: handler_logic
assertions.description: It adds a handler that receives from 'incoming_topic', prepends 'Processed: ' to payload, and publishes to 'outgoing_topic'.
